summary: RageSquid and No More Robots' procedural extreme-sports series, beginning with downhill mountain biking and moving into snowboarding and mountainboarding in Descenders Next.

entries.title: Descenders

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Descenders released for Linux, macOS, Windows, and Xbox One in 2019, then PS4, Switch, Xbox Series X/S, Android, and iOS. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for the procedural downhill biking game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use Xbox Series X/S as a strong console alternative and Switch/mobile only for portable play.

entries.remaster_caveats: Xbox Series X/S is a strong 120 FPS console route, but Windows remains the most flexible primary route.

entries.title: Descenders Next

emulation.notes: Run the Windows Early Access build natively and revisit after major updates/full release.

primary.why: Descenders Next released in Early Access for Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S on 21 July 2025, shifting from biking to snowboarding and mountainboarding. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible early-access route, while planned PlayStation versions should be added only after release.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Early Access build on Steam/PC Game Pass at the highest stable settings, understanding that content and features will change during development.

entries.remaster_caveats: Early Access game; content, sports, multiplayer, mod support, and platform coverage may change before 1.0.
